Açıkken bilgisayarlar, kurulu yazılımlar: While on, computers, installed software and help desk tickets are sent to GLPI; while off, nothing is sent. Nothing comes back from GLPI into POps.
GLPI'nin adresi; apirest.php kendiliğind: The address of GLPI; apirest.php is added automatically.
GLPI'de Kurulum → Genel → API → API iste: In GLPI: Setup → General → API → API client.
Yalnızca gereken yetkileri olan bir GLPI: The API token of a GLPI user that has only the rights the export needs.
Kayıtların oluşturulacağı GLPI varlığını: ID of the GLPI entity the items are created in (0: root entity).
Yalnızca değişen bilgisayarlar ve yeni t: Only changed computers and new tickets are sent.
Bu tarihten itibaren açılan talepler bir: Tickets opened from this date are sent once; later public replies are added as follow-ups.
GLPI'ye gönderim yeni bir kişisel veri a: Sending data to GLPI is a new transfer of personal data and must be named in the school's KVKK notice. The signed-in user, screen images and event records are not sent. POps never deletes an item in GLPI.
There were no changes to send.

Eşleme yok: bilgisayarların GLPI konumun: No mapping: the GLPI location of computers is left alone.
GLPI'de birden çok eşleşen ya da GLPI'de: Computers with several matches in GLPI, or deleted from GLPI.
Birden çok eşleşmede POps tahmin yapmaz:: With several matches POps does not guess: merge or delete the duplicates in GLPI. A computer deleted from GLPI is not created again by itself. "Forget link" makes the next sync look the device up again.
GLPI'deki konumun kimliği: ID of the location in GLPI
Eşlenen sınıftaki bilgisayarların konumu: Computers in a mapped lab get this location in GLPI. The location of an unmapped lab is left alone; no location is created in GLPI.
Bağlantı unutuldu; sonraki eşitlemede ye: Link forgotten; the next sync looks the device up again.

GLPI uygulama jetonunu kabul etmedi (Kur: GLPI did not accept the app token (Setup → General → API → API client).
GLPI bir uygulama jetonu istiyor (Kurulu: GLPI requires an app token (Setup → General → API → API client).
